edges.reason: _to recipient parameter is used in the balance credit of transfer.
_value parameter determines the amount subtracted and added in transfer.
_from parameter selects the balance and allowance debited in transferFrom.
_to recipient parameter receives the tokens in transferFrom.
_value parameter is subtracted from balance and allowance in transferFrom.
_spender parameter is the allowance key in approve.
_value parameter is written into the allowed mapping in approve.
_to parameter receives minted tokens in mint.
_amount parameter increases total supply and recipient balance in mint.
_value parameter is forwarded to super.burn in burn.
_who parameter selects the balance burned in _burn.
_newOwner parameter becomes pendingOwner/owner in transferOwnership.
_token parameter is the external contract invoked by reclaimToken.
Local balance is the amount passed to the external transfer in reclaimToken.
oldValue holds the allowance read and rewritten in decreaseApproval.
msg.sender is the debited account and must equal the balance owner in transfer.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance gates transferFrom.
msg.sender is the allowance owner written in approve.
msg.sender is the allowance owner modified in increaseApproval.
msg.sender is the allowance owner modified in decreaseApproval.
hasMintPermission requires msg.sender == owner before minting.
burn is guarded by onlyOwner which compares msg.sender to owner.
renounceOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner against msg.sender.
transferOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner against msg.sender.
claimOwnership requires msg.sender == pendingOwner.
reclaimToken is guarded by onlyOwner against msg.sender.
Constructor assigns owner directly from msg.sender.
transfer subtracts from the sender balance and adds to the recipient balance.
transferFrom mutates the balances mapping.
transferFrom decrements the allowed mapping of the caller.
approve writes a new allowance into the allowed mapping.
increaseApproval adds to the allowed mapping.
decreaseApproval subtracts from the allowed mapping.
mint increases totalSupply_.
mint increases the recipient balance in balances.
_burn subtracts the burned amount from balances.
_burn subtracts the burned amount from totalSupply_.
burn delegates to the internal _burn routine.
renounceOwnership would clear the owner state variable.
Claimable transferOwnership sets pendingOwner.
Ownable transferOwnership delegates to _transferOwnership.
_transferOwnership writes the owner state variable.
claimOwnership sets owner to pendingOwner.
claimOwnership clears pendingOwner to address(0).
Constructor initializes the owner state variable.
canMint modifier requires mintingFinished to be false before mint.
hasMintPermission gates mint on the owner state variable.
canMint modifier gates finishMinting on mintingFinished.
onlyOwner gates finishMinting on the owner state variable.
onlyOwner gates burn on the owner state variable.
onlyOwner gates renounceOwnership on the owner state variable.
onlyOwner gates transferOwnership on the owner state variable.
onlyOwner gates reclaimToken on the owner state variable.
onlyPendingOwner compares msg.sender to the pendingOwner state variable.
whenNotPaused modifier gates transfer on the paused state variable.
whenNotPaused modifier gates transferFrom on the paused state variable.
whenNotPaused modifier gates approve on the paused state variable.
whenNotPaused modifier gates increaseApproval on the paused state variable.
whenNotPaused modifier gates decreaseApproval on the paused state variable.
reclaimToken performs an external call on an owner-supplied token contract before completing its own state changes.
The user-supplied token address is the call target of the external transfer, allowing an arbitrary malicious contract to reenter.
Tokens retrieved by the external call are sent to the owner address.
